title: 5 Types Of GTA 6 Players
sources: Kotaku review: a more grounded game that requires more planning and consideration if you want to survive and succeed https://kotaku.com/grand-theft-auto-6-the-kotaku-review-2000757842

lines.text: Five types of GTA 6 players! Which one are you?
Number one, the Rusher! He runs in guns blazing, but reviewers say GTA 6 is more grounded, so you need to plan to survive.
Number two, the Explorer! Reviewers keep praising how dense the world is, and how people react to you.
Number three, the Driver! TheGamer says driving feels better than ever.
Number four, the Frame Counter! Rockstar is targeting thirty frames per second on every console, and he has opinions.
Number five, the Preloader! Rockstar says the pre-load needs up to two hundred twelve gigabytes, and he cleared his storage days ago.
The main story is around fifty to eighty hours, so you can be all five!
